newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: News of Kia M&A seen boosting Seoul stocks.
newsitem.headline: News of Kia M&A seen boosting Seoul stocks.

text.p: News of an agreement between Hyundai Motor 67510.KS and Daewoo Motor to promote a takeover of Kia Motors 67500.KS is expected to boost Seoul stocks, brokers said on Wednesday.
"That news, whether true or not, will raise hopes of an early resolution to the Kia crisis," said Lee Moo-il of LG Securities.
The composite stock index ended 1.24 points lower at 732.68 on Tuesday.
